name: Proposal Functional Requirements Modal
description: Client sees the four core cards (views, components, specific features and contextual cross-cutting features) and clicks a requirement group card to open its detail modal with items, icons and descriptions. Items with linked technical requirements show a 'Ver requerimientos (N)' link that opens a nested modal listing each requirement title, priority and description (detailed and executive modes; hidden on legacy proposals without item ids). El modal conserva uno o varios requerimientos por elemento y muestra configuration y usageFlow con su formato cuando existen, manteniendo propuestas antiguas sin esos campos.
